title: I want to start every trip this way
text: Dasha was such an excellent guide. A Great way to understand the culture at the beginning of my trip. We even got rained out and she was able to adjust our plans on the fly to still make the most of it. She sent us a long list of personal recommendation around the city at the end of the tour and that list was worth the money alone!
author: Jessica_G

title: Fun food tour

title: Great Barcelona and Catalan sampler.
text: Great way to find hidden eating and drinking spots and enjoy the company of fellow travellers. Highly recommended,  especially if you don't  know where to go or what to eat.

title: Worth the tour
text: Food, wine and tour guide were amazing.  It was great to get a history lesson in the trip, plus the flamenco was great afterwards!
author: Anita_H

title: Great
text: Thank you Hugo for a great experience in Barcelona. The tour was well organized, easy to follow, and helped us understand the city better. I would recommend it to other travelers.
author: johanneflo_04

title: Informative Food Tour - Great Guide!
text:
Berta was a great guide for this tour. She was knowledgeable, able to engage easily with all of us, offered history to go with the foods we tried and the fashion we were trying them in. We also got history along the way. At the end was the Flamenco show, which was worth the experience and not what I expected at all. 
Definitely recommend and you’ll luck out if you get Berta.
Thanks for a great tour Berta!
B&H from Canada
author: HELEN_S

title: Fabulous Barcelona tour!
text: Victor was amazing guide! So much knowledge and information! We loved this tour! We loved the park, and the church!
